name: Maintainer Inbox
author: David Boulay
description: Every open issue and pull request on the repositories you maintain, plus replies in your conversations anywhere on GitHub, with a desktop notification for each. Reads GitHub search directly, so watch settings and notifications marked read elsewhere can't hide anything.

barWidget.description: Issues and pull requests on your own repositories that are waiting on you, until you reply or dismiss them.

schema.label: Also watch
schema.description: Comma-separated. An owner or organization (lojel) covers all its repositories; owner/repo (lojel/lojel-wp) just that one. Your own account is always included.

schema.label: Replies in your conversations
schema.description: Issues and PRs anywhere on GitHub that you opened, commented on, or were mentioned or assigned in, when someone answers after you. Bot comments and reviews never count.

schema.label: Ignore bots
schema.description: Skip items opened by Dependabot, Renovate and other bot accounts.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: One per new issue, pull request or reply; a single summary when more than three arrive at once.

schema.label: Warn after failing for (minutes)
schema.description: The widget turns urgent when GitHub could not be checked for this long, so silence never means a failed check.
